status: Informational AI development cost estimate; usage unmeasured; no funding or payment request
agent_requirement_status: Developer's planned minimum for the target, not empirically proven capacity or purchased concurrency

workload_assumptions.selection_basis: Illustrative sensitivity scenario chosen to present non-round comparison totals; not measured usage or evidence of higher actual costs. Same quantities applied to every model.
workload_assumptions.cycle_definition: An assumed aggregate implement/review/debug cycle may contain several API calls; cumulative billed quantities, not a single prompt size
workload_assumptions.billing_assumptions: Standard synchronous text API, uncached input and billed output/reasoning; no batch, promotion or cache savings; exclude tax/tool charges

reserve_basis: Total estimate less modeled Qwen base; unmeasured allowance for extra tokens, tier/rate changes or selective premium review.
routing: Qwen mostly; selective premium review within reserve, no fixed premium tokens included in base

rmb.basis: Latest populated ECB reference date observed on 2026-11-10; indicative, not settlement quote

separate_direct_qwen_rmb_tariff.scope: Aliyun RMB tariff, Frankfurt/global or Beijing; different account/billing route, not substituted into USD baseline

scope: Most agreed core platform foundation and essential launch features targeted in 25 days; later extend systems. Not a measured percentage of all four phases or guarantee of external approvals.
comparison_limit: USD5835/4240 are illustrative premium-model scenarios for equal assumed billed counts, not universal provider costs or measured forecasts. Tokenizers, quality, retries and caching differ. Lower-priced alternatives exist.
unknowns: Account/region eligibility and quotas for ten workstreams
